recommendations.issue: Inconsistent food quality due to preparation, low-quality ingredients, or lack of attention to detail in the kitchen.
recommendations.action: Implement a standardized recipe and portion control system, conduct daily taste tests, and source higher-quality ingredients from new suppliers. Provide refresher training on cooking techniques for kitchen staff.
recommendations.expected_impact: Significantly improve customer satisfaction, reduce food-related complaints, and enhance the restaurant's reputation for quality.

recommendations.issue: Poor staff attitude and service quality, likely due to insufficient training, high turnover, or poor management oversight.
recommendations.action: Implement a mandatory customer service training program for all front-of-house staff, introduce a staff recognition program for excellent service, and conduct regular one-on-one performance reviews to address issues and motivate employees.
recommendations.expected_impact: Enhance the overall customer experience, improve staff morale, and reduce negative feedback related to service interactions.

recommendations.issue: Excessive customer wait times, stemming from understaffing during peak hours, inefficient kitchen operations, or poor table management.
recommendations.action: Analyze peak hour traffic patterns to optimize staffing levels for both front-of-house and kitchen. Streamline kitchen workflow processes and consider implementing a digital table management system to improve seating efficiency.
recommendations.expected_impact: Achieve faster service delivery, improve table turnover rates, and significantly increase customer satisfaction regarding wait times.

recommendations.issue: Pricing is consistently perceived as too high or not offering good value for money.
recommendations.action: Conduct a comprehensive competitive pricing analysis. Review menu item costs and consider introducing value-oriented specials, combo deals, or loyalty programs. Enhance perceived value through improved presentation, portion sizes, or unique offerings.
recommendations.expected_impact: Increase customer perception of value, potentially leading to higher sales volume and improved customer loyalty.

recommendations.issue: General unspecified operational issues or dissatisfaction not fitting other categories.
recommendations.action: Implement a proactive customer feedback mechanism (e.g., QR code surveys at tables, comment cards) to identify specific 'other' issues. Conduct a comprehensive operational audit to uncover hidden pain points and inefficiencies.
recommendations.expected_impact: Uncover and address previously unknown customer pain points, leading to targeted improvements and a more holistic positive experience.

recommendations.issue: Unappealing restaurant atmosphere due to outdated decor, poor lighting, uncomfortable seating, or excessive noise levels.
recommendations.action: Evaluate and update decor, improve lighting (e.g., warmer tones, dimmers), replace uncomfortable seating, and consider soundproofing solutions or background music adjustments to reduce noise levels.
recommendations.expected_impact: Create a more pleasant and inviting dining experience, encouraging longer stays, repeat visits, and positive word-of-mouth.

recommendations.issue: Poor cleanliness and hygiene standards within the establishment.
recommendations.action: Establish and rigorously enforce daily and weekly cleaning checklists for all areas (kitchen, dining room, restrooms, entrance). Increase cleaning staff hours if necessary and conduct regular, unannounced spot checks to ensure compliance with hygiene standards.
recommendations.expected_impact: Significantly improve customer perception of hygiene, reduce health risks, and create a more inviting and trustworthy environment.
